---
title: "Run the team-owned synthetic IPF workflow"
jupyter: python3
execute:
  enabled: false
---

This model-user workflow supplies a synthetic target and workspace to the
team-owned IPF façade. Composite topology, views, objectives, bounds, and
optimizer controls remain reusable model code.

## Set up the consumer workspace

Import only the public target and workflow façade.

```{python}
#| id: user-imports
from circuit_model import IPFTarget, optimize_ipf, resolve_ipf_optimization
from scnsim import units as u
```

## Supply the Design Target

These quantities are request inputs, not SCNSim defaults or acceptance Gates.

```{python}
#| id: user-target
target = IPFTarget(
    readout_frequency=6.2 * u.GHz,
    filter_frequency=7.1 * u.GHz,
    transfer_zero_frequency=6.6 * u.GHz,
    coupling=45.0 * u.MHz,
    combined_linewidth=2.0 * u.MHz,
    response_frequencies=tuple((5.0 + 0.02 * i) * u.GHz for i in range(151)),
)
workspace = "workspace/synthetic_ipf"
```

## Run the team-owned workflow

One façade call performs the model-owned optimization and winner analyses.

```{python}
#| id: user-run
workflow = optimize_ipf(
    target=target,
    workspace=workspace,
)
```

## Inspect the exact typed Results

Direct and pump-off HB expose parallel selected-network S/Y/Z surfaces;
`show()` only presents the materialized Results.

```{python}
#| id: user-show
workflow.optimization.show()
workflow.direct.s.show(magnitude="db")
workflow.hb.cases["pump_off"].s.show(magnitude="db")
workflow.report.show()
```

## Resolve after restarting the kernel

Exact resolve reconstructs the same sealed request and never reruns optimization
or selects a latest result.

```{python}
#| id: user-resolve
resolved = resolve_ipf_optimization(
    target=target,
    workspace=workspace,
)
resolved.show()
```
